name: sgs/choice-flow
title: SGS Choice Flow
description: A step-by-step quiz that branches to different questions based on the answer given, and ends in a result — not a single flexible form.

wrapper.label: Wrapper
wrapper._note: Visual-QA pass (2026-09-15, design-reviewer gap #1) added maxWidth + padding only — a DELIBERATELY MINIMAL box+width shape (content-block composition_role, not wrapper-shell-kind — see seed-composition-roles.py comment for this block). No colour/typography attrs; do not extend this element toward the full SGS_Container_Wrapper capability set without a design-gate (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

back.label: Back button
back._note: Rendered via the shared sgs_button_element_style_css() helper (includes/helpers-button-style.php), the same mechanism sgs/product-card's built-in CTA uses. Colour defaults deliberately do NOT match the theme's 'primary' button preset — real evidence read from the client's own real lens-configurator source (sites/eye-care-ward-end/design_handoff_ward_end_eye_care/Eye Care Birmingham.dc.html:1531) shows its Back/Close controls use a NEUTRAL ink/paper pair (background:none, border light, hover border darkens to near-black) — the brand accent colour is reserved there for progress-fill/price/badge highlights only, never the nav buttons. Defaults here mirror that: transparent background, `text`/`border` at rest, border darkens to `text` on hover, matching this codebase's own theme tokens for the same roles (2026-09-15).

flowId.description: FR-43-6: the slug of a sgs_choice_flow post (Choice Flows admin screen) this block renders in place of its own steps. Same by-slug reference as sgs/form's formId (Spec 42 §2).

flowIsLinked.description: True only when flowId was set by the Linked flow picker: the discriminator between 'not linked' (renders its own steps) and 'linked, but the flow post is gone' (renders the fallback). The flow post's own sgs/choice-flow never carries it, which is what stops a linked flow rendering itself.

backColourBackground.description: User-reported gap (2026-09-15): the Back button previously carried no operator-facing colour/border attrs at all — plain hardcoded CSS. Rendered via the shared sgs_button_element_style_css() helper, the same mechanism sgs/product-card's built-in CTA uses. Defaults deliberately NEUTRAL (transparent), grounded in the real lens-configurator source — see the 'back' element's own _note for the full evidence.

progressStyle.description: User-directed (2026-09-15): operator choice across the 3 real reference patterns found live — 'bar' (the client's own real lens-configurator: a plain thin fill bar, step name as separate text above), 'circles' (AthleanX: numbered circle stepper with connecting lines, above a separate plain bar), 'badge' (Invisalign: a step-count pill riding directly on the fill track, styled like a slider thumb).

showPricePanel.description: FR-43-19 (v1.4.0): shows a running-total panel beside the steps (two columns from 1024px, stacked below on narrower screens) — the product's current price, one row per chosen priced add-on, then the total. Display only; the server-side add-on price list (FR-43-18) is the sole price authority for what actually gets charged.

pricePanelTitle.description: FR-43-19 (v1.4.0): heading shown above the price panel. Bean's 2026-09-24 decision (plans/2026-09-24-eye-care-hand-build-design.md §5): default 'Your order', not the eyewear draft's client-specific 'Your pair'.

flowProductId.description: FR-43-20 (v1.4.0): the product this flow adds to the bag when it is NOT embedded on that product's own page (where the page's own product/variation is used instead — see render.php). 0 = none set; a flow with priced add-on steps and no product set here, opened off a product page, cannot resolve a base price.

progressColour.description: Root polish (Eye Care hand-build design gap): the progress bar fill's colour, a palette slug or hex. Empty = the existing default (the 'primary' token, unchanged from before this control existed).

showHeader.description: Root polish: an optional header row above the progress bar — a logo, a 'Step N of M' eyebrow and a Close button (only shown when the flow is inside an sgs/modal).

headerLogo.description: Root polish: the optional header's logo image, {id,url,alt}. Empty object = no logo shown.

closeLabel.description: Root polish: the header's Close button label, shown as visible text (with a decorative × alongside it, hidden from assistive tech).

stickyFooter.description: Root polish: pins the existing footer (Back button plus the terminal's primary action) to the bottom of the viewport while a step is in view.
